<Heading

  children={"Define (or revise) the engineered labor standard for a TaskType"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/standards"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



If a standard is already active for this TaskType, it is closed (its effective range ends now) and a new one starts — append-only history, never an in-place overwrite.

Idempotent retries: clients MUST always send a non-empty `Idempotency-Key` header (any unique value per logical request) when the Postgres backing is configured; a retried request with the same key and body replays the original response byte-for-byte instead of defining the standard a second time.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}

  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":false,"description":"A caller-minted unique key per logical request (e.g. a UUID). Clients must always send a non-empty key on POST /standards: with the Postgres backing configured, a retry carrying the same key and an identical body replays the original stored response instead of re-executing the create; the same key with a different body is rejected with 422 idempotency-key-reused. Declared required: false because the in-memory configuration accepts the request without a key (no transactional backing to gate on) — never rely on that in a real deployment.\n","schema":{"type":"string"}}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>
